peon.title: Red-Green
peon.tagline: Code until the tests are green.
peon.chain: Task → Barracks → Orc Council → Loot Vault
peon.loopBack: Forge: red tests → back to the same orc
steps: You move a task to In Progress. An orc picks it up.
Two reviewer agents check the patch until they agree.
Red tests send it back to the orc who wrote it.

knight.title: Night Watch
knight.chain: Alert mail → Totem → Barracks → Forge → Catapult
knight.loopBack: Refund mail → Reply Mill → Loot Vault
steps: A Sentry alert comes in. An orc fixes the bug.
Tests pass, the fix merges, the release fires.
Refund mail gets a template reply. No model, $0.
knight.you: You read the replies in the morning.

elf.title: Variants
elf.chain: Brief → Barracks → Orc Council → Lake of Insight
elf.loopBack: Loot Vault: rejected → back to the same orc
steps: Drop a brief. Orcs draw variants in parallel.
Critic, Accessibility and Copy agents review until they agree.
Reject one and it goes back with your reason.

lich.title: Daily Status
lich.chain: Calendar + Board + GitHub → Catapult → team chat
lich.loopBack: Review stuck 2 days → Orc Council → unblock plan
steps: Calendar, board and GitHub feed one digest.
It goes out only when all three are in.
A review stuck for 2 days gets an unblock plan.
lich.you: You read one message, not three tools.
lich.limit: Too much in progress sounds the alarm.
